answers: ㅂ: 방, 발 / ㅍ: 풀, 팔 / ㅃ: 뿔, 빵
exercises: Hold a tissue in front of your mouth and say 불, 풀 and 뿔. Which word should make the tissue move the most? Write that word.

Which sentence means 'It's raining.': 비가 와요 or 피가 와요?

letters.sound: plain b/p: soft, with only a little air
letters.as: Close to the p in "spin" (little air). Often heard as a soft b.

letters.sound: aspirated p: strong puff of air
letters.as: Close to the p in "pin" (strong puff of air).

letters.sound: tense pp: lips pressed tight, throat tense, no puff of air
letters.as: No exact English match. Like the p in "spin", but said harder and tighter, with no air.

objective: Tell apart and pronounce word-initial ㅂ, ㅍ and ㅃ. Choose the correct word from minimal-pair sets like 불/풀/뿔, 발/팔 and 방/빵.
summary: This worksheet covers the three Korean "p/b" letters at the start of a word: plain ㅂ, aspirated ㅍ and tense ㅃ. Each letter has an English cue and a set of easy words. You learn to tell the letters apart using minimal pairs such as 불/풀/뿔, 발/팔 and 방/빵. The exercises cover a tissue test, reading, sorting and choosing the right word.
